High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Dagobah, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Dengars Blaster Carbine _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iyI5A2kzlwsZV_7DYUYZeFzxQCF9Wn67/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Dengars Blaster Carbine _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,343,244 bytes, SHA-256 <code>349521048af8e035289326a10a07ece096be479eb6c1b6e8381e6465d19d8415</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This is a fan print, not a Decipher or Players Committee card. It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set, not a PC or Decipher publication)” and is not shown on [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (Bill, 22 November 2026).

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
